cards.text: This one's a song of David, Israel's king, written for the choirmaster with stringed instruments. David opens by crying out, asking God to hear his prayer. No small talk, no 'hey, how you been,' just STRAIGHT to it.
He's calling out to God from the ends of the earth. That's not the next room, friend, that's ONE bar of signal with your phone held up over your head.

cards.question: David is crying out to God from the ends of the earth. He says he calls out whenever his heart is ___.
David calls out to God whenever his heart is faint. Where does he ask God to lead him?

answers.text: To the rock higher than himself
To his father's house in Bethlehem

cards.text: Then David gives his reason, and it's about what God has already done: He's been a tower of strength for David against the enemy. Not a pep talk, friend, a whole building you can run INTO.

cards.question: David says God has been his ___ and a tower of strength against the enemy.

cards.text: Next, David asks to dwell in God's tent. He's not asking for a visit, friend. He's asking for a place to stay.

cards.question: David asks to dwell in God's tent. For how long?

cards.text: And he wants to take refuge in the shelter of God's wings. Friend, I spent years in the back of a junk drawer. Trust me, a shelter sounds GOOD.

cards.question: After asking to live in God's tent forever, David says God has heard his vows.
David says God has given him the inheritance reserved for those who fear His name. What does that say about David?

answers.text: He counts himself among those who fear God
He earned it by winning every battle
He was born into it as Jesse's son

cards.text: RESERVED, baker, like a seat with your name already taped to it. Then the prayer turns to the king.

cards.question: Now the prayer is for the king. What does it ask God to do for him?

answers.text: Increase the days of his life

cards.text: And may his years span many generations, baker. That's not 'happy birthday,' that's 'have ALL the birthdays.'

cards.question: Next, the prayer asks for the king to sit enthroned in God's presence for a set number of years.
The prayer asks God to appoint something to guard the king. What is it?

cards.text: To close, David makes a promise of his own. And this is no New Year's resolution that's gone by February, friend.

cards.question: David closes the psalm with what he will do day by day. What is it?

answers.text: Sing praise and fulfill his vows
Lead the army out to battle
